trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment every other trophy is earned. There is nothing to do for it directly — it is the reward for finishing the other 54. PlayStation shows it as a Mythic achievement worth 0G on Xbox.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the Platinum unlocks automatically right after the last one.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list. Finish the story first — the 100% checklist only appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits. The checklist is lenient: it is closer to 60% true completion, so you do not need everything. You need 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, and every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the five story chapters, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Work through the checklist: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret quests must all be complete; vehicles, animals and weapons only need a share of the total.
Clear 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the ten hardest. When the checklist hits 100%, A Long Road pops.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Complete the Gone Fishing mission in Chapter 1.

trophies.dispute: Most guides (PushSquare, KeenGamer, GTABase) list Paradise Lost as the Chapter 1 trophy; one list (GameTrek) places it at Chapter 2. This guide follows the majority.
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete Chapter 1 of the story.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete Chapter 2 of the story.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete Chapter 3 of the story.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete Chapter 4 of the story.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission in Chapter 5. It cannot be missed, and after the credits you keep free-roam of Leonida.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final story mission in Chapter 5.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Breakfast Run mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the Breakfast Run mission.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish The Cartel Heist mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist mission.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Child's Play mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the Child's Play mission.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Headliners mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the Headliners mission.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the VCIA Takedown mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Operation Savage Glory mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Andy's quests are Lucia-only. If you have not finished them during the story, the quest giver comes back in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Complete Andy's final mission (his strand is Lucia-only).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission. The quest giver returns in free-roam if you have not finished it during the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Complete Kenton's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. The quest giver returns in free-roam if you have not finished it during the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Complete Billy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. The quest giver returns in free-roam if you have not finished it during the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Complete Randy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Tyrone's quests are Jason-only. The quest giver returns in free-roam if you have not finished it during the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Complete Tyrone's final mission (his strand is Jason-only).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's unique animal hunt. Bret's quests are Jason-only, and every Bret quest is required for the 100% checklist, so do them all.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Complete Bret's unique animal hunt (his quests are Jason-only).

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.dispute: Guides agree on 8 strands, but differ on which stranger strands qualify — some count only the named side-character strands, others count any eight stranger mission chains. This guide counts any eight completed stranger strands.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands. Stranger missions appear as you explore Leonida; each strand is a short chain of missions for one stranger. After the story, every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back, so unfinished strands can be completed in free-roam. The eight that count are the qualifying strands — side-character final missions (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Play stranger missions as they appear while exploring Leonida.
Finish eight full strands; the quest givers return in free-roam after the story if any strand is unfinished.
Check Progress to see which strands are done — eight completed strands pop the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.dispute: KeenGamer counts 18 required meditation spots; PowerPyx and GTABase say only 'every spot' without a number. This guide uses 18, the only published count, and flags the difference.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The first is missable: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. The last spot cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Meditate at every spot to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and follow her to the balcony.
Accept her meditation invitation and complete the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 — this is the one spot that can be missed.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can play as both characters, visit the remaining spots.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: Find collectible cards across Leonida and complete three full sets. There are 18 card sets in the game; 15 full sets count toward 100% completion, but this trophy needs only three. Cards are found in the open world and in shops — check your collection under Progress to see which sets are close.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards from the open world and shops; each card belongs to a set.
Complete three full sets — the collection screen shows which sets are nearest to done.

trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app and use WAiNK It at 100 different spots across Leonida. Each location only counts once, so keep moving — the app marks spots you have already done. All 100 count toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app and use WAiNK It at a new spot.
Repeat at 100 different locations — the app shows which spots are already done.

trophies.guide: The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten. You only need 50 of them for this trophy — and 70 of 80 for 100% completion, so you may skip the ten hardest challenges entirely. Pick the easy groups first and check Progress to see which challenges are done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress to see the 80 challenges in their eight groups of ten.
Complete any 50 — pick the easiest groups first; the hardest ten can be skipped entirely.

trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open ground where you can break line of sight — the partner must be with you when the stars drop, so do not let them get arrested or left behind.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along and raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and lose the cops while your partner is still with you.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the Wanted Level dropping between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops, keep the robberies quick, and do not lose the cops between stops — the chain breaks if the Wanted Level clears.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three nearby shops and plan the route in advance.
Rob all three back-to-back with your partner, keeping the Wanted Level up between stops.

trophies.guide: Get in or scan 100 different vehicles. Scanning counts toward the 100% checklist too (200 of 277 vehicles), so scan everything you pass — the vehicle list under Progress shows what you have found.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Get in or scan 100 different vehicles; Progress shows what you have found.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a group — a gang operation or a wanted shootout gives you enough targets in one place.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of five or more enemies, activate Combat Focus, and take down five before it ends.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clear a jewelry store with no alarms and no witnesses. Go in quiet: take out the guard and the clerk silently, grab the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the trophy fails for that attempt — leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Enter the jewelry store undetected and take out the guard and clerk silently.
Grab the goods and leave with no alarm raised.

trophies.guide: Crack five bank vaults and get away each time. Each vault is a set-piece robbery: get inside, open the vault, grab the cash, then lose the pursuit. All five vaults count toward the 100% checklist, so they must all be done for A Long Road anyway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape the pursuit.
Repeat for five vaults in total — every vault counts toward 100%, so none can be skipped.
The trophy pops after the fifth successful escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and lose the pursuit. Ram or shoot the truck until it stops, grab the cash, then break line of sight and lose the cops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Stop an armored truck, take the cash, and lose the pursuit.

trophies.guide: Reveal every region of the map. Drive, fly and walk through each area until the whole map is uncovered — the map screen shows which regions are still hidden.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Reveal every region of Leonida on the map.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations — the map and your contacts point you to them. Check Progress to see which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find and rob an illegal operation for one gang.
Repeat for every gang in Leonida; Progress shows which gangs are still unhit.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations all pay in them. Hand them to a contact to launder; the total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up as you rob.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob banks, trucks and gang operations to earn Marked Bills, then launder them through a contact.
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops in the game. Weapons, clothes, cars and food all count — the total is cumulative, so it adds up naturally as you play. If you are short at the end, buy the most expensive weapon or vehicle you do not own yet.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map. There are eight purchasable garages — the map and property listings show which ones you still need. You need the cash first, so this one usually comes late.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn enough cash, then buy each garage property on the map.
The trophy pops when the eighth and final garage is purchased.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Steal or buy a vehicle, open the app, and register it — repeat for ten different vehicles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Register ten different vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them. The stunt counter under Progress shows your total — repeat the easy jumps to grind the number up.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Land stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps across Leonida.
Watch the stunt counter under Progress; repeat easy jumps until it reaches 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type on the map. There are nine activity types — the map marks each venue, and the Progress screen shows which types you have tried. One round of each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the map and find one venue of each activity type.
Play one round of each of the nine types; Progress shows which are done.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.dispute: KeenGamer counts 42 Shooting Range Gold Medals; PushSquare and the official description say only 'all Shooting Range challenges' without a number. This guide uses 42, the only published count.
trophies.guide: Gold every challenge at each shooting range. There are 42 Shooting Range Gold Medals across the ranges (KeenGamer's count). Each range has several challenges — score gold on each one. The shooting-range screen shows which challenges are still below gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Earn a gold medal on every challenge at that range.
Repeat at every range until all 42 gold medals are earned.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each Top Fun venue. There are 14 locations (KeenGamer's count). Each venue hosts its own race — win it once and move to the next. The Top Fun menu shows which venues you have won at.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Open the Top Fun menu and pick a venue you have not won at.
Win the drone race at that venue.
Repeat at all 14 venues; the menu shows which are done.

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races — not the same race 20 times. Any race type counts: street races, drone races, boat races and more. The race menu tracks which ones you have won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races; the race menu shows which you have won.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and out-fish him in his fishing challenge. Cal appears at a fishing spot — take his challenge and land the better catch to win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish any arcade cabinet game. Walk up to an arcade machine, start a game, and play it to the end — any cabinet counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Start any arcade cabinet game and play it to completion.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a full game there — the follow-through is the point, so finish the game you start.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
steps: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Trigger the unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Head to the airport and find the departure — it is a one-off stunt you can trigger at any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and trigger the unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: Complete the Rhino-related challenge. The exact method is unconfirmed — no two guides agree on the steps yet. Try the Rhino tank in free-roam; the trophy is flagged unconfirmed until players pin the method down.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Use the Rhino tank in free-roam; the exact unlock method is still unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot with the view. Head to the Ocean Beach bar, order the cocktail, and enjoy it — the trophy pops once you have had your drink with the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Order a cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot and enjoy the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a showroom window. Get a car inside or at the entrance of a vehicle showroom, then smash straight out through the glass in classic GTA style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom window.

trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. The description is deliberately vague — it is tied to a story moment with your partner. It cannot be missed; it pops as you play the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play through the story; the trophy unlocks at its story moment.

trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to a choice in the campaign. The description is deliberately vague — it pops when you make the choice. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play through the story; the trophy unlocks at its choice moment.

trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. The description is deliberately vague — it is tied to a story moment. It cannot be missed; it pops as you play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play through the story; the trophy unlocks at its story moment.

trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. The description is deliberately vague — it is tied to a surprising story moment. It cannot be missed; it pops as you play.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Play through the story; the trophy unlocks at its story moment.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Take out a target with a melee drive-by. Drive past a target and hit them with a melee weapon from the vehicle. The exact method is still being confirmed by players — it is flagged unconfirmed until the steps are pinned down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Perform a melee drive-by elimination; the precise method is still being confirmed.
